  "summary": "Today features a calendar conflict between [[P_KID1]]'s soccer practice and family dinner at [[P_GRANDMA]]'s. Additionally, [[P_KID1]]'s field trip permission slip is due tomorrow.",
  "briefing_md": "# Morning Briefing for [[P_DAD]]\n\n### ⚠️ Time-Critical Action Items\n* **Permission Slip Due Tomorrow**: [[P_KID1]]'s signed permission slip for Friday's science center field trip is due back **tomorrow, Monday, September 1st**. Please sign it today and remember to pack a sack lunch for Friday.\n* **Calendar Conflict Tonight**: [[P_KID1]]'s soccer practice (17:00 - 18:30) overlaps with family dinner at [[P_GRANDMA]]'s (17:30 - 19:00). I have proposed a calendar adjustment and drafted a message to [[P_GRANDMA]] to push dinner back to 19:00.\n\n### 📅 Upcoming Events\n* **Tomorrow**: [[P_KID2]] has a dentist appointment from 09:00 to 10:00.",
